summary: The round 5 fixes do what they set out to do, and I found no correctness bug they introduce. R5-1 moves the check for whether links were asked for ahead of every other reading of a link (`clearUnasked`). The two calls to `honourLinks` match its new signature, and the revise-only pass still passes `noRecord`. R5-2 adds a `decided` list to `forceAskRules`, and on a reshape it is the same `Object.keys(roundDecisions)` that `checkDrafts` gets. R5-3 puts the left-decision handling into `leaveDecision`, which `resolveWith` and the reshape loop now both call. I traced the paths that read a dropped disposition afterwards (`awayFromDefer`, `endsIn`, `isDeferral`, `leftDeferred`, `needCommits`, `keptDecline`, the hold after a reshape), and they behave the same for a left finding. Inside `resolveWith` the new `option` gate changes nothing, because a pick on a left call only ever sets `defer`. The loop test was not run, because the guard refuses `node` to the reviewer.
